select a.id,a.warehouse_no,a.deduct_weight,a.add_time,a.state, b.license_plate,b.job_no,b.job_type,b.card_no, d.warehouse_id,d.grain_grade, e.grain_variety, f.gross_weight,f.tare_weight from task_flow_warehouse_item a left join task_flow b on (a.task_id=b.id) left join task_flow_quality_item d on (d.task_id=b.id) left join task_flow_sample_item e on (e.task_id=b.id) left join ( select task_id,sum(gross_weight) as gross_weight,sum(tare_weight) as tare_weight, sum(gross_weight)-sum(tare_weight) as net_weight from ( select task_id,case weight_type when 1 then weight end as gross_weight, case weight_type when 2 then weight end as tare_weight from task_flow_weight_item ) tb group by task_id ) f on (f.task_id=b.id)
and a.add_user=#{userId}
and (to_char(a.add_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= #{startTime})
and (to_char(a.add_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= #{endTime})
order by a.add_time desc

select a.job_no, b.warehouse_id,b.grain_grade,b.deduction,b.deduction_price, c.gross_weight,c.tare_weight, d.grain_variety from task_flow a left join task_flow_quality_item b on (a.id=b.task_id) left join ( select task_id,sum(gross_weight) as gross_weight,sum(tare_weight) as tare_weight, sum(gross_weight)-sum(tare_weight) as net_weight from ( select task_id,case weight_type when 1 then weight end as gross_weight, case weight_type when 2 then weight end as tare_weight from task_flow_weight_item where task_id=#{taskId} ) tb group by task_id ) c on (a.id=c.task_id) left join task_flow_sample_item d on (a.id=d.task_id) where a.id=#{taskId}
select a.*, b.name as add_user_name from task_flow_warehouse_item a left join base_user_info b on (a.add_user=b.id) where a.task_id=#{taskId} and a.state=1
